units: <cite ref="Niddah 73a:14">Nidd. 73ᵃ</cite> <he>ראוי לס׳</he> fit to begin with it the count (of the seven days of purification); <cite ref="Niddah 73a:14">ib.</cite> <he>לסְפִירַת או כי תזוב</he> for the count required in the case described <cite ref="Leviticus 15:26">Lev. XV, 26</cite>, sq. Sifra Emor, Par. 10, ch. XII (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 23:16">Lev. XXIII, 16</cite>) <he>כל סְפִירָתָם לא וכ׳</he> all they have to count (from Passover to the Feast of Weeks) shall be no more than fifty days.

<cite ref="Leviticus 23:16">Ib.</cite> <he>ס׳ שהיא תלויה בב״ד וכ׳</he> a count which depends on the court (deciding on the New Moons), to exempt the weekly Sabbath, <he>שסְפִירָתָהּ בכל אדם</he> which everybody counts; <cite ref="Menachot 65b:11">Men. 65ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="O01379"><he>סְפִירוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Menachot 65b:11">Ib.</cite> <he>כל ס׳ שאתה סופר וכ׳</he> all the counted days together shall be no more than fifty (v. supra); a. e.—Yalk. Chr. 1075, v. <cite ref="O01340"><he>סְפוֹרָה</he></cite>.
Gitt. 21ᵇ; Succ. 24ᵇ (ref. to ספר, Deut. XXIV, 1) לסְפִירַת דברים וכ׳ (the word sefer refers not to the writing material but) merely to the act of writing the words (formula of divorce).
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 936">Yalk. Deut. 936</cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 15b:4">Erub. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>לספִירוּת</he>.
